_comment_top: Video-prompt template. Compatible with Veo 3.1 and Seedance 2 JSON-prompt conventions (2026 industry-standard); should also map cleanly to Gemini-video and Sora when those expose JSON inputs. Schema follows the 5-part formula: Cinematography + Subject + Action + Context + Style&Ambiance, with named fields aligned to Veo/Seedance.
_comment_references: References point at character/scene/product entries by slug. References are hydrated at compose time before submission.
title: REPLACE — short human-readable shot title

shot_sequence._comment: One element per shot. For single-shot videos, this array has one element. For multi-shot videos, list shots in order.

cinematography.camera_movement: static | pan-left | pan-right | tilt-up | tilt-down | dolly-in | dolly-out | tracking | handheld

subject._comment: Hydrated from character entries. Identity and core_traits are frozen across all shots in this video.

action._comment: Per-shot. What the subject does over the duration.
action.description: REPLACE — e.g. 'walks from doorway to kitchen counter, picks up mug, takes a sip, looks toward window'
action.ambient_sound: REPLACE — e.g. 'morning birds outside, kettle finishing in background'

context._comment: Hydrated from scene entry. Per-shot override allowed.

negative_modifiers: no fabricated UI elements not in product entry

music.license_basis: REPLACE — e.g. 'royalty-free / production-music-library / generated-with-suno' (must be cited)
